intelligence.human_view: This is one teaching in four parts, and each part needs the others. Craft: flatness is the defect, at any size — a white-glow wash over black flattens the picture and kills the text, and "a little flat" is still flat. The fix is depth everywhere: every part, every text, a real object with obsidian depth, layered elevation, its own deep color as its light. Knowledge: the emblem is settled fact, not a choice to re-make — NAYA_ICON.png, the most beautiful render, taken verbatim, never redrawn, placed on an angle in every corner because that is what gives the high-level effect. Honor: the standard is the identity — eliteness, triple-A, fine art, inside and out, in every way — and the governing principle is to optimize for what software should be at its absolute best, never for what it has traditionally been. Multiplication: the simple rules carry the standard into the system without a curve or a banner — one point per star, one tap on a clean "+" to compose, the emblem elegantly wherever it makes sense. Beauty without substance is decoration, not excellence — the standard is five pillars, and the quality is the proof.
intelligence.simple_view: Nothing may look flat — not even a little bit! Every picture must be deep and real, like a shiny black jewel. The pretty emblem goes in every corner, tilted just so. One star means one point. The mail button is a big clean plus. And everything must be the very best — never just okay!
intelligence.grandma_view: Nothing may look flat, dear — not even a little bit! Every picture must be deep and real, like a shiny black jewel. The pretty emblem goes in every corner, tilted just so. One star means one point. The mail button is a big clean plus. And everything must be the very best — never just okay!

THE TRUE EMBLEM — NAYA_ICON.PNG, TAKEN VERBATIM — ON AN ANGLE IN EVERY CORNER AND ELEGANTLY THROUGHOUT NAYANET WHEREVER IT MAKES SENSE. ONE POINT PER STAR. THE MAIL IS A CLEAN "+". WHEN IT LOOKS FOR REAL, THEY TAKE YOU FOR REAL. NEVER ACCEPT 8/10 WHEN A PRACTICAL PATH TO 10/10 EXISTS.
